video_title: Stephon Marbury tells Mad Max what China is REALLY like

quotes.speaker: Stephon Marbury
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury on his experience being traded to the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Best experience ever, turned into the worst experience ever, now the best experience ever.

text_blocks.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
text_blocks.text: In 2005 you got traded to the Knicks. I know you were excited about that, and your reactions. What do you remember about being traded to the Knicks?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephon Marbury
text_blocks.text: Too hype. Best experience ever, turned into the worst experience ever, now the best experience ever. Basketball was an emotional rollercoaster throughout our time period. The first time I got there was the biggest, best high ever I could any basketball player probably could ever have.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Marbury
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury on his decision to leave the NBA and move to China
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't going to conform. I wasn't that type of person or player, so I left.

text_blocks.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
text_blocks.text: You decided to make your way on the CBA. What prompted the move?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephon Marbury
text_blocks.text: When I left, it was pretty much at that point there was nothing else to do. I wasn't going to conform. I wasn't that type of person or player, so I left. And when I went, I was depressed. I wanted to kill myself during a period of time. I didn't kill myself, I didn't act on it, but that's what I felt. I had to clear that up to see the mental illness is real.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Marbury
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury on the mission behind his Starbury shoe brand
quotes.excerpt: Access for all for people who couldn't afford. I come from where I come from.
quotes.quote: 14.98. Right? Access for all for people who couldn't afford. I come from where I come from. My mom had seven kids, she couldn't afford to do it. We grew up on food stamps, WIC, everything like everybody else from the hood. But understood the importance of giving back, making sure that we created something that people would be able to attach themselves to with someone who comes from where they come from. My ideology is treat people the way you want to be treated, and it paid back sevenfold.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Marbury
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury on the difficulty of playing against Terrell Brandon
quotes.excerpt: I tell dudes, there's a lot of dudes I played against y'all never mention what I did.

text_blocks.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
text_blocks.text: Some of your toughest matchup, man, when you was playing? And who was the damn toughest to real guard?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephon Marbury
text_blocks.text: Everybody every time I say it, people be like, Terrell Brandon. And I'm like, you don't know. If you don't know, ask everybody who played against him. I tell dudes, there's a lot of dudes I played against y'all never mention what I did to y'all. But y'all always mention them other dudes. The dudes that never did nothing all the time to you. I'm talking about all the time. I got the numbers to back that thing.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Marbury
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury on the skill level of Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: I love Steph Curry. He's one of my favorite from the skill set and the whole level.
quotes.quote: I love Steph Curry. He's one of my favorite from the skill set and the whole level. I fell in love with the Olympics, I fell in love with Steph Curry. I watched him and I seen what he did, but when I seen it live, it was different live. I like Ja, I love Drew Holiday. All of the guards from all of the teams and I'm not leaving anybody out. I'm saying all of them. I can't think of everybody right now. Steph Curry is an older guy and when I look at him, I look at him as the pinnacle of the guards of how and what a sound guard can embody.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Marbury
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Marbury on the unique talent of Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: I think he's the most different out of everybody. He's so freakish alien style.
quotes.quote: I like the kid one Bama. I think he's the most different out of everybody. He's so freakish alien style. It's just different.
